gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-montserrat-: Wide-mouthed round letters crowd up toward the capital line, reading like chalkboard lowercase. Montserrat Alternates sits beneath Capture Smallz, whose big-bodied lowercase feels raw and tactical, a display face over sans-serif text.
gen-dafont-cheri-fs-asap: Calligraphic, sturdy, and plainly inviting. Cheri's wiry line glides under the eye, and Asap, a plain sans with open-arc c forms and a body nearly as tall as its capitals, gives it a readable footing.
gen-dafont-cheri-fs-public-sans: Calligraphic charm, drawn with one steady line that makes Cheri's lowercase look sturdy, large, and quite cute. Public Sans, a plain sans, adds hefty lowercase and broad open counters.
gen-dafont-disorder-gf-montserrat-altern: Montserrat Alternates is round, wide-mouthed sans text with chalkboard lowercase. Disorder, a display face with no swelling at curve joins and glyphs spaced well apart, looks big and chaotic above it.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-lexend-mega: Dogica stands heavy and commanding, its widely tracked lowercase rising close to the capitals. Lexend Mega, a sans drawn with one nib and a visible gap in every c, feels approachable and modern beside it.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-lexend-peta: Heavy and commanding, Dogica tracks wide with lowercase near capital height. Lexend Peta, a sans with unthinned curves and a big x-height, should read steadily across many lines of text.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-montserrat-alternat: Dogica's distinctly wide tracking spreads its heavy lowercase far apart. Montserrat Alternates, a plain sans with an open c and chalkboard lowercase, reads smoothly across a full page of text.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono reads like pins standing in a wide board. Beneath the cast-iron stature of Edo SZ, this sans keeps a compact skyline and curves as sturdy as its stems, so text moves along steadily.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-lexend-giga: Edo SZ has lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, held to a single constant stroke width. Lexend Giga, a sans-serif, spaces its words generously for relaxed reading.
gen-dafont-edo-sz-gf-lexend-mega: Cast-iron presence with a classic air, Edo SZ keeps a constant stroke width throughout. And Lexend Mega, a plain sans with a visible gap in every c, brings an approachable modern hand.
